wiki.title: Kelly Morrison
wiki.extract: Kelly Louise Morrison (born February 2, 1969) is an American physician and politician who has served as the U.S. representative for Minnesota's 3rd congressional district since 2025. A member of the Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party, she served from 2019 to 2023 in the Minnesota House of Representatives and from 2023 to 2024 in the Minnesota Senate.
